condition: recombinant cargo-free WT shell expressed in E. coli
source: Sigmund et al. 2019; Giessen et al. 2019
notes: Recombinant cargo-free WT QtEnc shell. Sigmund et al. 2019 directly reported T=4 icosahedral symmetry and an approximately 43 nm shell diameter; the corresponding E. coli-derived cryo-EM map EMD-4879 was reconstructed at 3.4 Å. The empty shell has a reported melting temperature of 86.6 °C. No separate PDB atomic model is assigned to this empty-state map.
